$comment: Copy to theme.json to customize Cortex (gitignored). Pick a theme in the UI (Settings -> Theme) or set themeId here; the preset (see app/lib/themes.ts) supplies the logo, subtitle, and color palette. brand.name is the fixed identity. To hand-tune, add a brand.logo / brand.tagline / colors map (token name -> value, e.g. "gold-500": "#...") and they win over the preset.
